title: A Framework for Automated Multi-Source Satellite Data Analytics and LLM-Based Report Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.05625v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents the workflow for building an automated ArcGIS Pro tool using ArcPy to extract the Land Surface Temperature (LST) from Landsat 7, 8 and 9 datasets. The tool eliminates the need for manual band selection and repetitive raster computations by automating the multi-step workflow of radiometric calibration, NDVI-based emissivity correction, and thermal conversion. In addition to supporting batch and single-scene processing, the tool has an optional Large Language Model (LLM) for statistical result interpretation and reporting. Depending on batch size, the tool reduced the processing time from around 11-58 minutes when done manually to around 4-11 minutes using the tool. We tested the tool with data from Ras Al Khaimah (RAK) in the UAE, and the LST obtained for Ras Al Khaimah ranged from approximately 25C to 50C, demonstrating an accurate LST mapping compatible with the weather conditions of RAK. translated_title: 一个自动化多源卫星数据分析与基于大语言模型报告生成的框架
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了使用 ArcPy 构建自动化 ArcGIS Pro 工具的工作流程，用于从 Landsat 7、8 和 9 数据集中提取地表温度（LST）。该工具通过自动化辐射定标、基于 NDVI 的发射率校正和热转换等多步骤工作流程，消除了手动波段选择和重复栅格计算的需要。除了支持批量和单景处理外，该工具还配备了可选的大语言模型（LLM）用于统计结果的解释和报告生成。根据批处理规模的不同，该工具将处理时间从手动操作的约 11-58 分钟缩短至使用工具时的约 4-11 分钟。我们使用来自阿联酋哈伊马角的数据对该工具进行了测试，获得的地表温度范围约为 25°C 至 50°C，展示了与哈伊马角当地天气条件相符的准确地表温度制图结果。
tldr: 本文开发了一个基于 ArcPy 的自动化 ArcGIS Pro 工具，可从 Landsat 7/8/9 数据中自动提取地表温度并利用大语言模型自动生成分析报告，将处理时间从 11-58 分钟缩短至 4-11 分钟，并在阿联酋哈伊马角数据上验证了制图的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated ArcGIS Pro tool built with ArcPy that extracts Land Surface Temperature from Landsat 7/8/9 data with optional LLM-based report generation, reducing processing time from 11-58 minutes to 4-11 minutes, and demonstrates accurate LST mapping validated on data from Ras Al Khaimah, UAE.
